strongest_angle: The International Organization for Standardization released the second edition of ISO 11228-3:2026 in May 2026, replacing the 2007 version to update ergonomic standards for repetitive upper limb tasks.

key_facts.fact: The International Organization for Standardization published the second edition of ISO 11228-3:2026 in May 2026.
The new ISO 11228-3:2026 standard supersedes the previous version, ISO 11228-3:2007, which has been officially withdrawn.
Intertek Inform lists the purchase price for the ISO 11228-3:2026 standard at 258.00 US dollars.
The British Standards Institution implemented the ISO 11228-3:2026 standard in the United Kingdom through its Technical Committee PH/9/ -/4.
